subject.title: fix(agy): pass print prompt as flag argument

question: Should Summarize restore compatibility with current Antigravity by placing extracted prompt content in argv, despite the current main contract that deliberately keeps it on stdin?
rationale: The implementation can mitigate application error leakage but cannot remove OS-level argv visibility, so choosing compatibility over the existing confidentiality boundary requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Accept Guarded Argv Transport
options.body: Merge the tested implementation and explicitly own process-list exposure and prompt-size limits as Antigravity-specific constraints.

options.title: Preserve Stdin Confidentiality
options.body: Keep prompts out of argv and replace broken Antigravity runs with a clear incompatibility error until a safe transport is available.

recommendation.title: Accept Guarded Argv Transport
recommendation.body: Merge the tested implementation and explicitly own process-list exposure and prompt-size limits as Antigravity-specific constraints.

likelyOwner.reason: The released runner and its current documented confidentiality contract fall within Peter Steinberger’s dominant area history.
